AN ORDINANCE IMPOSING A 9-1-1 CHARGE ON PREPAID WIRELESS SERVICE WITHIN THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, Part 4 of Article 2 of Chapter 5 of Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, as amended by Act No. 187, Georgia Laws 201 1, authorizes counties and cities that operate a 9-1-1 public safety answering point to impose a 9-1-1 charge on prepaid wireless service at the retail point of sale; and,

WHEREAS, pursuant to Code Section 46-5-134.2 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated such charges may be imposed at the rate of 75 cents per retail transaction; and

WHEREAS, revenues received by a county or municipality from such charges must be deposited in the emergency telephone assistance fund maintained by the county or municipality; and

WHEREAS, imposition of the charge on prepaid wireless service is contingent upon the enactment of an ordinance or resolution of the county or municipality; and

WHEREAS, the Town of Clermont, Georgia participates in a 9-1-1 public safety answering point operated by a joint 9-1-1 authority with each of the following jurisdictions: Hall County.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia and it does hereby ordain as follows:
2: In accordance with O.C.G.A. § 46-5-134.2, there is hereby imposed a prepaid wireless 9-1-1 charge as defined by O.C.G.A. § 46-5-134.2(a)(4) upon every prepaid wireless retail transaction occurring within the jurisdiction of the public service answering point (occurring within the Town of Clermont) in the amount of 75 cents.
3:
Prepaid wireless 9-1-1 charges collected by sellers shall be remitted to the Commissioner of the Department of Revenue at the times and in the manner ptovided by Chapter 8 of Title 48

of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated with respect to the sales and use tax imposed on prepaid wireless calling service.
4: The Clerk of the Town is hereby directed to file with the State Revenue Commissioner a certified copy of this ordinance and amendments thereto, in accordance with O.C.G.A. § 46-5-134.2(j)(1), within ten (10) days of enactment of this ordinance.
5: In accordance with O.C.G.A. § 46-5-134.2(j)(5), funds received by this Town (on behalf of the applicable County) from charges imposed by this ordinance shall be deposited in the Emergency Telephone System Fund maintained by Hall County) pursuant to O.C.G.A. § 46-5- 134 and kept separate from general revenue of the jurisdiction; all such funds shall be used exclusively for the purposes authorized by O.C.G.A. § 46-5-134 (f).
6: All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed.
7:
The ordinance shall become effective January 1, 2012.

BEIT ORDAINED this (7 day of “December __. 2011, by the Town

Council of Clermont, Georgia.
